scene funnydildoscene1
I make my way over to the bar to hang out with Sana for a bit.
She’s cleaning off the counter when I arrive...which, thanks to my above average deductive reasoning, I know means there were likely real customers tonight.
Could it be that handing out a few fliers and hiring an ex Yakuza wife actually increased business somehow?
: You certainly look happy tonight.
: Do I?
: Unless you’re smiling for no apparent reason.
: If that's the case, allow me to change that last sentence to, “You certainly look menacing tonight.”
scene funnydildoscene2
: I...think happy is closer to the right answer.
: But not entirely the right answer.
scene funnydildoscene3
: I think that maybe...relieved is the word you’re looking for.
: It’s been a while since we had actual customers.
: Even those two old ladies who used to hang out in the back of the room stopped showing up a while ago.
scene funnydildoscene1
: But...tonight, we had a handful of people that I’ve never even seen before.
: And how many of them ordered drinks that you didn’t have the ingredients for?
scene funnydildoscene4
: All of them...
scene funnydildoscene1
: But...they were understanding when I told them we could only serve beer and wine for the night.
: And...now I guess I have...more ammunition in...getting my mom to order actual liquor.
: Does Sara even have the money to get actual liquor?
: Does Sara what now?
scene funnydildoscene5
Sara and Yuki come out of the back room and make their way over to Sana and me.
Sara stands defiantly behind the counter and Yuki-
Well...Yuki just stands, I guess.
: Yo.
: Good evening, Sensei.
: Now, what were you saying about having enough money to buy actual liquor?
: Oh. I was just asking if you had enough money to buy actual liquor.
: Reasonable question.
scene funnydildoscene6
: Hmph.
: I do recall a time where that may have been a worry of mine.
: But I’ll have you know that the one and only Sakaki-Bar-A is back on top.
: Please tell me the name of this place isn’t actually the “Sakaki-Bar-A.”
scene funnydildoscene7
: Wait, you really didn’t know that?
: You’ve been coming here for how long now?
: Good question, Sara. Why don't you answer it for me?
scene funnydildoscene8
: Um...I know we...had a good night, but...I don’t think we should let one good night go to our heads...
: We...still have a lot of work to do...
: I know, I know.
: But, since all three of us did wonderfully tonight, I was thinking that maybe we could all go out for a little celebration.
: Okay. Guess I’ll just go fuck myself then.
scene funnydildoscene9
: Okay, the four of us can go out for a little celebration.
: Is that really the best course of action?
: Why wouldn’t it be?
: I mean, I take it that you finally generated some sort of profit tonight. It would be a bit of a shame to just blow that all on a post work celebration, wouldn’t it?
: Sensei is...actually giving good advice for a change...
: Hey, what happened to all of that stuff about how I helped you face your fear of people and pasta?
scene funnydildoscene10
: Guh...
: It’s not like I was planning on going out to some fancy restaurant or anything...
: Yuki told me about some place she normally goes to in the old district, so I was thinking that maybe we could all grab dinner there before heading home.
: Tojo Ramen?
: You know it.
scene funnydildoscene11
: The old district is...a little too far for me, I think...
: I’m...kind of tired from working all night and...I don’t even think the buses are running right now...
scene funnydildoscene12
: But we were all gonna ride on Yuki’s motorcycle together and it was gonna be fuuuuun...
: I...don’t even know if that’s legal?...
: It’s not, but no one’s gonna fuckin’ care.
: And I’m assuming I’d just be walking.
scene funnydildoscene13
: Of course not! You’d be riding with us!
: Four people on one motorcycle? I’ll pass.
: You passed when it was just two as well, ya fuckin' pussy.
: Yuki, come on. Not in front of one of my students.
: It’s okay, Sensei...I’m...a little afraid of motorcycles as well...
: I’m not-
: Yeah, yeah. We all know how brave and strong you are.
: Sara, not you too. You’re supposed to always be on my side.
scene funnydildoscene14
: Put a ring on it and maybe I will be~
: Pass.
scene funnydildoscene15
: At least hesitate a little, jerk!
: Brutal.
: Um...if Sensei and I...both don’t really want to go...
: I guess we could stay here and...close up...
: As long as I don’t have to actually do anything.
: I’ve...already handled most of it, so...
scene funnydildoscene16
: You’re really sure you don’t want to come, Sana?
: It’s been a while since the two of us have gone out to dinner together.
: We could always go another time. I just...don’t really want to right now...
: If...that’s what you really want...okay...
scene funnydildoscene17
: I’m leaving her in your hands then, got it?
: It will be good practice for when you decide to settle down with me and become Sana’s new daddy.
: I really wish all of you mothers would stop trying to get me to be your daughter’s new father.
scene funnydildoscene18
: Yo! Don’t fuckin’ lump me in with that shit. I ain’t ever asked for that.
: Not yet you haven’t.
: Ain’t gonna fuckin’ happen, man. Quit while you’re ahead.
: How am I-
: As much as I’d love to hang around and listen to you two “not flirt” with each other, I’d also love to eat before it’s time for me to pass out for the night.
scene funnydildoscene19
: You good to go then?
: Should probably put on a jacket if you don’t wanna get cold. Body heat’s not good for shit when you’ve got the wind blowin’ right at you.
: It’s near the door. I’m ready whenever.
scene funnydildoscene20
: Be good.
: Uhh...okay?
: Night, man. See you around or whatever.
scene funnydildoscene21
Sara and Yuki make their way out of the store, leaving Sana and me alone in the bar for what I imagine is the millionth time.
Tonight feels a little different, though.
For one, it’s the first time I’ve ever had to watch her really clean anything.
But not only that, we’re still coming off of a relatively awkward and uncomfortable exchange about her brother that I really hope doesn’t come up again any time soon.
scene funnydildoscene22
: So...I guess it’s just us again...
: I guess it is.
: What else do you have to do before we can get out of here?
: Are we...going somewhere?
: Because I wasn’t really lying about being tired...
: Well, if you’re closing, there’s not really any point in hanging around, is there?
: I figured I’d just walk you back to the dorm or something like-
I inadvertently pause when I remember an important detail about the thing I literally just thought about not thinking about.
If her brother was killed while walking home, is something like that some sort of trigger for her?
Is the sheer idea of walking home enough to evoke the same negative memories a lock of hair can?
These are the things I’m forced to think about for her sake now.
All because she wanted to make something of hers mine.
: ...Sensei?
: Oh, sorry.
: I just figured we’d walk back to the dorm or something.
It wouldn’t be the first time anyway.
I’m likely just overthinking things at this point.
scene funnydildoscene23
: Sure...
: I’m just going to run up to my mom’s room to grab a few DVDs before we leave...
: Ayane’s been looking for a lot of...lighthearted romantic comedies lately and...I’m pretty sure my mom has a ton of those...
: Don’t you need to finish cleaning first?
: I think it’s...clean enough, right?
: It’s not like we were...extremely busy...
: Just...busier than normal...
: Hey, you’re the employee. I’m just some guy who hangs out here and talks to you every once in a while.
scene funnydildoscene24
: Then...in that case...wait here.
: I’ll be right back.
scene black
Sana tosses the rag she’d been using to wipe down the counter into a large blue bin and quietly makes her way up the stairs.
I scan the room to see if maybe she missed a chair to push in or something like that.
I don’t really know how nice this place is supposed to look when it closes.
And it’s not like I’d actually help either since I’m not being paid.
But I could at least tell her about it when she comes back...
Ten minutes later...
scene barnight
Sana still hasn’t come downstairs.
I was hoping things wouldn’t come to this as I am also tired and really don’t want to summon the energy to go up there.
But I guess a real concern with her is that if a dresser fell down or something like that, she could be stuck beneath it for life.
I will save you, Sana.
Granted, I probably would have heard something if a dresser fell down or...
Ugh.
Fuck it.
I sigh to myself and tap into my energy reserves and head for the stairs.
scene black
jump funnydildox
label funnydildox:
Meanwhile...
scene funnydildoscene25
scene funnydildoscene26
: Hey. Any bookshelves fall down in here?
: Sana?
scene funnydildoscene27
: Is everything-
: Ha.
: It’s just...
: It’s just...sitting there...
: Do you know what that is?
scene funnydildoscene28
: Of course I know what that is! I’m a [teenager]! I...know things!
: Okay, but you’re also Sana, so...
: Be quiet! Why are you even up here?!
: You’ve been gone for ten minutes. Is this what you’ve been doing the whole time?
: Why is it just laying there on the bed?!
: Okay, so I guess this is what you’ve been doing the whole time.
: Things like that should stay hidden!
: Or at least on a...shelf or something!
: If you don’t like where it is...put it back?
: How?! I don’t want to touch it!
scene funnydildoscene29
: Fine. I’ll just put it back then.
scene funnydildoscene30
: Ahhh no! That’s even worse!
: I’ll just...
: I’ll do it!
: Why is this even a thing you-
: Just...shut up already!
scene funnydildoscene31
: Ohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygod.
: Couldn’t you just...leave it there?
: No! I already told my mom I was borrowing things from her room, so she knows that I have to come in here!
: If we just left it on the bed, she’d know I saw it!
: That would lead to a very awkward conversation that I don’t want to have!
: So I have to...put it away so we...don’t have to talk about it!
: Counterpoint, what if your mom just doesn’t mind her daughter knowing that she-
scene funnydildoscene32
: Sh-Shut up! I don’t want to hear it!
: This feels like something straight out of one of those games Makoto’s store sells.
: Can you please just...direct me to a..shelf or something?
: Isn’t that still in plain-
: It’s better than right on the bed at least!
: Um...go to your left?...
scene funnydildoscene33
: Here?
: Sure. That’s not the bed.
: Just put it down so we can leave.
scene funnydildoscene34
: If we could...never talk about this again...that would be very...
scene funnydildoscene35
: Very...
: Huh?
scene funnydildoscene36
: Is this...
scene funnydildoscene37
: Sana?
: Did you find another dildo?
I make my way across the room to find Sana holding something, but I can’t quite make out what-
scene funnydildoscene38
: Why are these here?
: Why is what here?
: Is that a condom?
: My mom hasn’t seen anyone in a really long time.
: So why are these here?
: Why would I know? It's not like they're mine.
I’ve never even used a condom with Sara before.
I don’t know if she’s just holding onto them in case she...decides to start practicing safe sex or something, but I don’t really care either way.
scene funnydildoscene39
: Why does she have them, Sensei?
: Sana, do you think I’m somehow involved in this?
: Should I not?
: That’s what I’m saying.
: And all of those things she says about wanting to marry you?
: Is that just you two joking around?
: None of that has anything to do with-
scene funnydildoscene40
: How gullible do you think I am?!
: Sana, relax.
: No!
: Why are these here?!
You know-
I don’t deserve this.
Am I actually sleeping with Sara?
Yup.
But I’m being yelled at right now for something I don’t even play a part in.
Now, if she were to have actually caught me in the act, that would be another story.
But I should be able to get out of this.
I was made for this sort of thing, after all.
: Why not ask your mom about it before you go jumping to any conclusions?
scene funnydildoscene41
: Why not ask my mom?...
: Probably because I’ve told her over and over again that I don’t want her to have that sort of relationship with you.
: She’ll just tell me what I want to hear even if it's a lie.
: Maybe she’s just...keeping them in case I change my mind and decide to be with her after all?
scene funnydildoscene42
: Sana, I-
: You know I’ve been suspicious this whole time, right?
: It’s one thing if it’s with Ayane...but my mom?
: Do you have any idea how that makes me feel?
: How what makes you feel, Sana?
: I already told you this has nothing to do with me.
: Maybe...Maki just gave them to her in case of an emergency or something.
: That would sure be convenient, huh?
: You’re the only man she talks to, Sensei.
: And you came right up to her room when I never came back downstairs.
: Which means you’ve been in here before.
: Which means you've-
: I’ve carried her up the stairs when she’s gotten black out drunk.
: Oh yeah?
: What else?
: What do you mean what else?
scene funnydildoscene40
: I MEAN WHAT ELSE!
: DON’T LIE TO ME!
: Jesus Christ, Sana. Calm the fuck down and listen to me for a second.
scene funnydildoscene39
: Whatever you think is going on...it’s not.
: Your mom and I are just friends.
: And even if we weren’t, do you really think either one of us would be dumb enough to just leave condoms lying around?
: I mean...your mom left an actual sex toy on her bed. I think it’s safe to assume that she might just be trying to mess with you or something.
: Really. Just try talking to her about it instead of jumping to conclusions.
: But it was...such an easy conclusion to jump to...
: I never liked how quickly you two started being...friendly with one another.
: I was...always afraid of this happening.
: Afraid of how you’d realize how good of a match you are and just...
: Just what, Sana?
: Can you...
: Can you promise these aren’t yours?
: I can.
: And I swear to do anything you ask of me if you find out I’m lying about that.
: Anything?
: Is there something in particular you want?
scene funnydildoscene43
: ...yeah.
: I want things to stay the way they are now...
: The way things are right now is pretty bad. You’re crying and holding an unidentified condom in your hand.
: Not like that, Sensei...
: With you at arms length...
: From everyone...
: Everyone?
: Everyone.
: You see how much better I’ve gotten...
: And...you even know one of my biggest secrets now...
: If things change...I might change too...
: And it wouldn’t be...in a good way...
: So please...promise me...you’ll stay away from my mom...
: Sure. But first, I’m going to need you to apologize for accusing me of all of this.
scene funnydildoscene44
: If I’m wrong...which I really...hope I am...
: I’m sorry...
: It just...didn’t seem like they could belong to anyone else...
: Like I said, they’re probably just there because of Maki or something.
: Or, maybe Sara is weird and uses them on the dildo you grabbed off the bed so she doesn’t get pregnant with a giant rubber baby.
: Come on. Are you really going to keep crying after that?
: Yes.
: But...
: Just for a little while longer...
scene black
So-
It appears that I managed to nearly avoid a head on collision.
And, just as all good head on collisions do-
It came out of nowhere.
And to think that I didn’t even have to break any promises in order to escape.
Would I have still agreed to her promise if she had asked me to stay away from Sara entirely?
Sure.
But I’d break it.
Promising that a few contraceptives don’t belong to me is, frankly, much better- as it allows me to fall asleep a little easier in knowing that there was one less lie told tonight.
Though, of course many people would believe this entire ordeal was what you’d call “lying by omission.”
That’s not lying at all.
It’s bending the truth in a way that’s convenient for everyone.
I’m doing Sana a favor by secretly fucking her mother instead of letting her in on the secret.
She can have a new secret. One I’ll make just for her.
It won’t possess the same value of the one she shared with me-
But it will be our melatonin.
And allow us to dream a little bit easier.
I walk Sana back to the dorm and we ignore the last half hour of our lives.
